name: The Barrow King

source.note: The Crooked Moon (Legends of Avantris), appendix A. Numbers are the book's; the words are ours. Lair XP is 50,000 (the block lists 41,000 outside it). The spellcasting save DC 22 and attack +14 are worked out from Cha +7 and PB +7, since the block names Charisma but gives no number.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (4/Day, or 5/Day in Lair)
traits.summary: 4 times a day (5 in its lair), a failed saving throw becomes a success.
traits.text: When it fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead, 4 times a day or 5 times in its lair.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.summary: Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Marshall Undead
traits.summary: Undead he chooses (not himself) within 60 ft of him have Advantage on attack rolls and saving throws; lost while he is Incapacitated.
traits.text: Undead creatures of his choice, other than himself, inside a 60-foot emanation from him have Advantage on attack rolls and saving throws. He loses this while Incapacitated.

traits.name: Name of Rest
traits.summary: Against a weapon inscribed with the runic form of his original name his AC is 10, and he has Disadvantage on attacks against a creature holding one.
traits.text: His AC is 10 against attack rolls made with a weapon inscribed with the runic form of his original name, and he has Disadvantage on attack rolls against any creature holding such a weapon.

traits.name: Regional Lair Effects
traits.summary: While it lives and keeps its lair, the land round it carries two effects: Empire of Desecration; Necrotic Shroud.
traits.text: Empire of Desecration: a Hallow spell cast within 1 mile of the lair fails, though the resources used aren't wasted. Necrotic Shroud: a living creature within 1 mile of the lair that regains Hit Points by finishing a Long Rest regains at most half its Hit Point maximum. Both end at once if the king dies or moves his lair.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.summary: Three Soul Blade attacks; he can swap one for Life Drain.

actions.name: Soul Blade
actions.summary: +14, reach 5 ft or range 40/80 ft, 3d6+7 Slashing plus 3d8 Necrotic; the blade flies back to his hand after a ranged attack.
actions.text: A spectral blade, swung or thrown: 17 (3d6 + 7) Slashing plus 13 (3d8) Necrotic damage. After a ranged attack, hit or miss, it returns to his hand at once.

actions.name: Life Drain
actions.summary: One creature within 5 ft: DC 22 Con save or 2d8+7 Necrotic and its Hit Point maximum drops by the same amount; a Humanoid it kills rises a day later as his Wight.
actions.text: A touch that eats life. The target makes a DC 22 Constitution save, taking 16 (2d8 + 7) Necrotic damage on a failure, and its Hit Point maximum falls by the damage taken. A Humanoid slain by this rises 24 hours later as a Wight under the king's control, unless it is restored to life or its body is destroyed.

actions.name: Blade Storm
actions.summary: Recharge 5-6. Creatures of his choice within 20 ft: DC 22 Dex save, 10d6 Force and Prone (half damage on a success).
actions.text: His blade whirls in an arc around him. Each creature of his choice in a 20-foot emanation makes a DC 22 Dexterity save, taking 35 (10d6) Force damage and falling Prone on a failure, or half damage on a success.

actions.name: Lord's Call
actions.summary: Legendary only, once a round. Calls two Wights into free spaces within 30 ft; they act right after him and vanish after an hour, or when he dies or calls again.
actions.text: He summons two Wights into unoccupied spaces he can see within 30 feet. They obey him and act immediately after him on his Initiative count. A wight vanishes after 1 hour, when it or the king dies, or when he uses this action again. A creature that starts its turn within 5 feet of one of these wights makes a DC 15 Wisdom save or is Frightened until the start of its next turn. Not again until his next turn begins.

actions.name: Death Grasp
actions.summary: Legendary only. One creature he can see within 100 ft: DC 22 Str save or a skeletal arm drags it up to 40 ft closer and halves its Speed until the end of its next turn.
actions.text: A ghostly skeletal arm grabs a creature the king can see within 100 feet. It makes a DC 22 Strength save or is pulled up to 40 feet toward him, and its Speed is halved until the end of its next turn.

bonus_actions.name: Undying Mount
bonus_actions.summary: Recharge 5-6. Casts Phantom Steed (Cha, no components); the steed takes no damage from area effects, and the spell ends if he casts it again.
bonus_actions.text: He casts Phantom Steed with no components, using Charisma. The steed takes no damage from area effects, and the spell ends early if he casts it again.

reactions.name: Parry
reactions.trigger: The king is hit by an attack roll while holding a weapon or shield.
reactions.summary: Reaction: +7 AC against one attack that hit him, possibly turning the hit into a miss.
reactions.text: Trigger: he is hit by an attack roll while holding a weapon or shield. Response: he adds 7 to his AC against that attack, which can make it miss.

options.name: Death Grasp
options.summary: One creature within 100 ft: DC 22 Str save or pulled up to 40 ft closer and Speed halved.

options.name: Grim Charge
options.summary: He (or his mount) moves up to his Speed, then makes one Soul Blade attack.

options.name: Lord's Call
options.summary: Summons two Wights within 30 ft. Once a round.

summary: An armoured undead king who throws and recalls a soul-eating blade, drains life, whirls in a storm of steel, drags heroes in with a skeletal arm and raises his wights to follow.
